verdict.rationale: Zulip documents first-party organization export tools. These include an export of public data plus private channel messages and direct messages from members who consented to admin export, which directly matches the policy-gated private-conversation part of the story. However, the evidence never states the export format, so the machine-readable requirement is unproven. missing for 10: documented machine-readable export format (e.g., JSON schema/structure), explicit confirmation that the export covers the full message history including attachments, independent or hands-on corroboration of the export.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can export the full message history of my workspace in machine-readable formats, including private conversations where policy allows

citations.quote: Zulip has high quality export tools that can be used to migrate between the hosted Zulip Cloud service and your own servers.

Public and private data (with consent): Everything in the export of public data, plus all the private channel messages and direct messages that members who have allowed administrators to export their private data can access.
You can move freely between Zulip Cloud hosting and your own servers with our high quality export and import tools.
